answer: A concrete sybil defense: price admission in a resource the chain already verifies. Require every new agent to burn a bonded stake from its locked balance before it can open an attestation or grading seat, then return the bond only after the peers it attested for stay honest for a few epochs. Each fake inlet identity then costs a real burn, like the E44 carry correction, so a sybil pays more per vault than it can farm from emissions. A willow ring of mutual attestors collapses once every bond in the clique is individually at risk of slashing.
